name: Glass tier pyramid
oneLiner: a stepped glass pyramid builds from the base up in real 3D, each tier dropping onto the last with a squash and a run of light, the values printed on its front faces; the top tier lands lit in the accent and a crown glyph drops onto the apex with a ring of light
say: when the speaker stacks levels from the many at the bottom to the few at the top ('a $1 product, a $10 one, a $100 one, and at the top the $1,000 offer'): each tier lands on its number, the crown on the top one
